claims: UFC 327 took place at the Kaseya Center in Miami, Florida.
UFC 327 was headlined by a light heavyweight title fight where Carlos Ulberg knocked out Jiří Procházka in the first round.
UFC 327 featured a co-main event for the flyweight title between Joshua Van and Tatsuro Taira.
Carlos Ulberg defeated Jiří Procházka via first-round knockout to become the new UFC light heavyweight champion.
Cub Swanson defeated Nate Landwehr via knockout.
Aaron Pico vs. Patricio Pitbull was a preliminary matchup at UFC 327
